blocks.text: Llama 4 Scout is a open-source language model from Meta, released on Apr 5, 2025.
At $0.08 input and $0.3 output per million tokens, it ranks #1 of 40 for input price, placing it the most affordable in this dataset.
Its context window of 10M tokens ranks #1 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
It targets long-context, budget, vision workloads.
Throughput is measured at 109 tokens per second (ranked #11 of 23 for throughput).
10M token context; 17B active params in a 109B MoE, single H100 deployable.
